# appdynamics_synthetic_api_job (Resource)

An AppDynamics Synthetic API Monitoring job: a scheduled scripted check of an API endpoint, grouped under an appdynamics_synthetic_api_application. Uses the Controller's own internal API (verified live), same as appdynamics_synthetic_web_job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appdynamics_synthetic_api_application" "checkout_api" {
  name = "Checkout API Monitoring"
}

resource "appdynamics_synthetic_api_job" "health_check" {
  application_id = appdynamics_synthetic_api_application.checkout_api.id
  description    = "Checkout API health check"

  api_metadata_json = jsonencode({
    script = {
      contentType = "JAVASCRIPT"
      script      = <<-EOT
        const assert = require("assert");
        (async () => {
            var response = await client.get("https://api.example.com/health");
            assert.equal(response.statusCode, 200);
        })()
      EOT
    }
  })

  location_codes  = ["M50"]
  timeout_seconds = 15
  user_enabled    = true

  schedule_run_configs_json = jsonencode([
    {
      rate       = { value = 15, unit = "MINUTES" }
      daysOfWeek = ["SUN", "MON", "TUES", "WED", "THUR", "FRI", "SAT"]
      timezone   = "UTC"
    }
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_metadata_json` (String) JSON object {"script":{"contentType":"JAVASCRIPT","script":"..."}} describing the API check script.
- `application_id` (Number) ID of the appdynamics_synthetic_api_application this job is grouped under.
- `description` (String) Job name, shown in the Controller UI's Jobs list.
- `location_codes` (List of String) Synthetic monitoring location codes, e.g. ["M50"].
- `schedule_run_configs_json` (String) JSON array of run-schedule configs, e.g. [{"rate":{"value":15,"unit":"MINUTES"},"daysOfWeek":["MON"],"timezone":"UTC"}]. rate.value must be 1-59 for MINUTES.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Job timeout in seconds (5-300 per the docs).

### Optional

- `composable_config_json` (String) JSON object describing resource-error-detection rules. See the Splunk AppDynamics Synthetic Monitoring API docs for the shape.
- `performance_criteria_json` (String) JSON object describing pass/warn/critical performance thresholds. See the Splunk AppDynamics Synthetic Monitoring API docs for the shape.
- `user_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the job actively runs on its schedule. Defaults to false, same as appdynamics_synthetic_web_job (verified live).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-locking version, incremented by the API on every update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import appdynamics_synthetic_api_job.health_check 10499/4af8bead-8ad9-4668-a073-4accf2f48079
```
